title: spec(data): add a shared NULL-distinct `unique` conformance case-set beside value-roundtrip and the filter sets, so every driver proves two NULLs do not collide
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPi25XXKx92Xmg4viS

Ruled: 6595804527 · letter A · 2026-11-03T04:55Z
Ruling-ref: 6595804527

Filing gate: ③ escalation of the server lane's contract review on #29278 (record 6577415377), recorded in its landing note 6578310168: the card's "Wanted" case-set lives in `packages/spec/src/data`, outside the server lane's claim. Handed to the spec lane. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.
Reader: `domain:spec` (the case-set and its census registration); each driver's adoption follows in its own lane.

## What is missing

PR #29339 (#29278) made `driver-mongodb` treat two `null` values in a `unique` field as distinct, matching `driver-sql` and `driver-memory`. The agreement is measured in that PR, but no shared case-set asserts it, so a fourth driver (or a regression in one of the three) can collapse NULLs onto one key and every driver-conformance cell stays green. It is the gap `value-roundtrip-conformance.ts` describes for value storage: no case-set, no evidence.

## Done when

- `packages/spec/src/data/unique-null-distinct-conformance.ts` (name per the house pattern) declares the canonical cases: two rows with `null` in a `unique` field both insert; an absent value behaves as `null`; two equal non-null values still collide with the driver's unique refusal; a compound unique key with one `null` member does not collide (measure what the three drivers do today before writing that row, and cite the measurement — every row is a measured value or a control, as in value-roundtrip).
- The case-set is registered with the driver-conformance census (`scripts/check-driver-conformance.mjs`) the way the existing sets are, so a driver that does not run it is scored.
- Spec patch, `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none` (test-support export only; if the census needs a new public export name, it is named in the PR for the maintainer).
- Driver adoption (`driver-sql`, `driver-memory`, `driver-mongodb`, then the rest) follows in the drivers' lane, one PR each, citing this card.

Dedupe: #29278 / PR #29339 (landed, the mongodb fix). **New.**
